scope: experimental assembled-operator AMS; CPU-owned setup, GPU-owned application and coarse solves
host_role: Windows small acceptance; CI idle, A100 not started or used

timing_context.method: No repository CI active or queued; two idle probes five seconds apart before measurement.
timing_context.limits: Idle desktop and caller-owned sessions retained; operationally idle host, not an exclusive hardware reservation.
timing_context.comparison: CPU native CG versus GPU MEX gateway; setup excluded, GPU gateway validation/allocation included.

cpu_stopping_norm: NGSolve CG preconditioned residual; iterations include initial residual check
gpu_stopping_norm: Euclidean residual, checked with full FP64 operator; iterations count updates
memory_measurement: Available-memory delta and live-workspace samples; not allocator peaks
